note: JPEGSetupEncode() (libtiff/tif_jpeg.c) sets sp->h_sampling = td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[0] and sp->v_sampling = td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[1] straight from the TIFF directory's YCbCrSubsampling tag -- populated from the untrusted input file by tif_dirread.c during TIFFReadDirectory(), with no range validation applied there -- then, with no zero-check on either field anywhere in the function, uses both as the divisor of a `%` (modulo) expression a few lines later: `td->td_tilelength % (sp->v_sampling * DCTSIZE)` (tile height), `td->td_tilewidth % (sp->h_sampling * DCTSIZE)` (tile width), and `td->td_rowsperstrip % (sp->v_sampling * DCTSIZE)` (rows per strip, non-tiled case). A subsampling factor of 0 makes any of these an integer-divide-by-zero trap.

traces.message: sp->v_sampling assigned from td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[1] -- the untrusted input TIFF's YCbCrSubsampling directory tag, parsed with no range validation by tif_dirread.c during TIFFReadDirectory()
td->td_tilelength % (sp->v_sampling * DCTSIZE) -- integer-divide-by-zero trap if sp->v_sampling is 0; no zero-check on sp->v_sampling anywhere in JPEGSetupEncode()
sp->h_sampling assigned from td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[0] -- the untrusted input TIFF's YCbCrSubsampling directory tag, parsed with no range validation by tif_dirread.c during TIFFReadDirectory()
td->td_tilewidth % (sp->h_sampling * DCTSIZE) -- integer-divide-by-zero trap if sp->h_sampling is 0; no zero-check on sp->h_sampling anywhere in JPEGSetupEncode()
sp->v_sampling assigned from td->td_ycbcrsubsampling[1] -- the untrusted input TIFF's YCbCrSubsampling directory tag, parsed with no range validation by tif_dirread.c during TIFFReadDirectory()
td->td_rowsperstrip % (sp->v_sampling * DCTSIZE) -- non-tiled-image sibling of the same unguarded division, integer-divide-by-zero trap if sp->v_sampling is 0
